A batch-geometry verification failure stopped the worker at 19:08 UTC and was detected at 19:31 UTC. The repaired check passed at 19:37 UTC; pilots resumed at 19:38 UTC. The two-hour preparation deadline stopped the 16th trial during development evaluation at 20:00:02 UTC. Fifteen trials completed, one had trained but lacked a development endpoint, and 34 never started. No main schedule, selected learning rates, main training or test evaluation followed. The bottleneck was the preparation allocation, not a measured scientific failure of KL training.
